description: This PHP class defines a 'Column' for reporting headers in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for column identification, pinning, size, cell properties, and methods to manipulate and retrieve these attributes. The class facilitates the creation and configuration of report header columns used in generating reports within the HRM system.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a report column header with properties like name, property identifier, pinning options, size, and cell properties. Provides methods to set and get the attributes and to serialize the column to an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Column object with a property identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the column.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the column.

methods.name: getProp
methods.description: Returns the property identifier of the column.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets the property identifier of the column.

methods.name: getPin
methods.description: Returns the pinning status of the column (start/end/null).

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Sets the pinning status of the column after validating permissible values.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the column.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the column.

methods.name: getCellProperties
methods.description: Returns additional cell properties for the column.

methods.name: setCellProperties
methods.description: Sets additional cell properties for the column.

methods.name: addCellProperties
methods.description: Adds or replaces cell properties with the provided array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the column properties into an associative array.
